info.name: rental-api
info.description:
Manual testing of rental-api, in user-journey order. Select the "rental-api local" environment first. See docs/manual-testing.md for the full walkthrough.

Auth: every protected request sends the collection's Bearer {{accessToken}}; "OTP verify" and "Refresh" save the tokens into the environment automatically. Public requests (health, auth) are set to No Auth.

request.description: 200 with database and redis both `up`; 503 if either is down.

200 `{ expiresInSeconds: 300 }`. The code is printed in the `npm run start:dev` terminal (`[SMS] To +2519…: Your rental code is …`): copy it into the environment variable `otpCode` before "OTP verify". Max 3 requests per phone per 10 minutes (A3).
200 `{ accessToken, refreshToken, accessTokenExpiresIn }`. The test script saves both tokens into the environment. Creates the account on first sign-in.

exec: // Saved for every protected request ({{accessToken}}) and for refresh/logout.

request.description: 200 with a new pair (saved automatically); the old refresh token is revoked. Reusing an old one within 60 s still works (A5 grace); after the new one was used, reuse revokes every session (401 `INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN`).

exec: // Saved for every protected request ({{accessToken}}) and for refresh/logout.

request.description: 204 always (also for an unknown or already-revoked token). Sign in again afterwards.

exec: // The refresh token is revoked now; clear it so it isn't reused by mistake.

request.description: 200, your profile and `verificationStatus`. 401 `ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRED` after 15 minutes: run "Refresh".
200 with the updated profile. `preferredLanguage` (`am`, `om`, `en`) is the only editable field.

201 `{ verificationUrl, sessionToken }`; open `verificationUrl` (also saved to the environment) in a browser. Needs the sandbox Didit values in `.env` (else 503 `VERIFICATION_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`). Within 30 minutes the same session is returned (V2). Other answers: 409 `ALREADY_VERIFIED` / `VERIFICATION_IN_REVIEW`, 403 `VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE`, 429 `VERIFICATION_RETRY_LIMIT`.

200 `{ status, canRetry, retriesLeftToday, canRequestManualReview, retryAvailableAt, reasonCode? }`. `retryAvailableAt` is an ISO UTC timestamp only when out of tries (3 sessions in 24 h, nothing to resume): when a new session can start. Otherwise `null`.

200 with the new status (`manual_review`) only at the retry limit after a Didit decline; otherwise 409 `MANUAL_REVIEW_NOT_AVAILABLE` (or `ALREADY_VERIFIED` / `VERIFICATION_IN_REVIEW`, 403 `VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE`). Check "Status" → `canRequestManualReview` first.

item.name: 5. Expected failures
item.description: Each request here should fail; its description says how, and its test checks it.

item.name: Fresh OTP code (for the next request)

request.description: 200. Sends a new code so "Wrong OTP code" has a live code to guess against (after "OTP verify" the previous code is used up). Counts toward the 3 OTP requests per phone per 10 minutes (A3): if you get 429 `OTP_RATE_LIMITED`, wait `retryAfterSeconds`.

Expect **400 `OTP_INVALID`** with `attemptsRemaining` (run the request above first; against an already-used code you get `OTP_EXPIRED` instead). Each try uses one of the code's 5 attempts (A2); after the 5th: `OTP_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED`. If 000000 happens to be the real code, you just signed in.
Expect **400 `INVALID_PHONE`**: only Ethiopian mobile numbers (+2519…, +2517…) may sign up. No SMS is sent.
Expect **400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`**: name and date of birth can never be changed by the user (V9). Nothing is saved.
Expect **401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`**: every route except health and auth needs an access token.

item.name: 6. Admin
item.description: Staff routes. Create an account with `npm run admin:create`, put its email/password into the environment (`adminEmail`, `adminPassword`), then run **Admin login**. Admin requests send `Bearer {{adminToken}}`, never the app token.

request.description: 200 `{ accessToken, accessTokenExpiresIn: 28800 }`; saved as `adminToken`. Every failure is 401 `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`; >10 per IP per 15 min: 429 `RATE_LIMITED`.
200 `{ id, email, role }`.
200 `{ items, nextCursor }`, newest first (any staff role). Filters: `targetId`, `adminId`, `action`. For the next page add `before={{nextCursor}}`. Your logins appear as `admin.login`.
200 `{ items, nextCursor }`: undecided manual_review + blocked, oldest first. The test saves the first item's id as `attemptId`.
Didit's values (`provider*`) beside the effective ones, identity kinds, history.

Moderator+. Add `documentType` + `idNumber` (+ `issuingCountry` for passports) only for an attempt with no Didit identifier; `dateOfBirth` / `fullName` correct the effective values. Errors: see the endpoint description in Swagger.
Moderator+, manual_review attempts only. `reasonCode`: PHOTO_UNCLEAR, DOCUMENT_EXPIRED, DOCUMENT_NOT_ACCEPTED, DOCUMENT_NOT_VERIFIED, UNDERAGE.
Any staff role. Status, identity kinds, active bans, attempts. Set `userId` (e.g. from the queue's `user.id`).
Moderator+. 200 `{ userId, status, identitiesBanned }`; 409 `ALREADY_BANNED`.
super_admin only. 409 `NOT_BANNED`.
Any staff role. Sorted by sub-city, then name. `subCityId=` filters; `includeInactive=true` adds deactivated ones. Saves the first one as {{neighbourhoodId}} and its sub-city as {{subCityId}}.
Moderator+. 201. 404 `SUB_CITY_NOT_FOUND`; 409 `NEIGHBOURHOOD_EXISTS` (same English name in the sub-city, ignoring case, deactivated ones included). Audited as `neighbourhood.create`.
Moderator+. One or both names. 400 `NO_FIELDS_TO_UPDATE`; 404 `NEIGHBOURHOOD_NOT_FOUND`; 409 `NEIGHBOURHOOD_EXISTS`. Audited with the old and new names.
Moderator+. Hidden from GET /areas; existing listings keep it. 409 `NEIGHBOURHOOD_ALREADY_INACTIVE`. `note` optional.
Moderator+. Back in GET /areas. 409 `NEIGHBOURHOOD_ALREADY_ACTIVE`. `note` optional.

Any staff role. Listings in `status` (default `pending_review`), oldest submission first; never drafts. Each row: summary, `photoCount`, a signed `coverUrl`, the lister's verified name and the flag codes (`MANY_ACTIVE_LISTINGS`, `UNLISTED_NEIGHBOURHOOD`, `CONTACT_IN_TEXT`). Page with `after=<nextCursor>`. Saves the first row as `adminListingId`.

Any staff role. Everything the reviewer needs: exact location and landmark, photos as signed links (15 min), flags with details, the lister (verified name, verification and account status; **no phone**), their other listings, and the history. Saves `adminListingVersion` for approve and reject.

Moderator+. pending_review → live; the photos become public. Send the `version` from the detail (saved by **Listing review detail**). 409: `ALREADY_DECIDED`, `LISTING_NOT_REVIEWABLE`, `LISTING_CHANGED` (the lister edited it: open the detail again), `LISTER_NOT_ELIGIBLE`, `ACTIVE_LISTING_LIMIT`. 503 `STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Moderator+. pending_review → rejected. `reasonCode`: PHOTOS_UNCLEAR, PHOTOS_DONT_MATCH, WRONG_LOCATION, MISSING_INFORMATION, DUPLICATE_LISTING, GUIDELINES (suspected fraud: neutral, and then **no** `listerNote`, else 400 `LISTER_NOTE_NOT_ALLOWED`). `listerNote` (≤ 300) is shown to the lister; `note` (required) is staff-only.

Moderator+. live or stale → removed (close reason staff_takedown); photos unpublished, the CDN purged (logged only, until production has a CDN). No version. Other states: 409 `LISTING_NOT_REVIEWABLE`. Find a live listing with **Listing review queue** and `status=live`.
Moderator+. Returns `{ phone }` and records the reveal in admin_actions (who, which listing, the note; never the number). Support: 403 `INSUFFICIENT_ROLE`.

request.description: Expect **401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`**: app and staff tokens are never interchangeable (S3).
No token. 200: the 11 Addis Ababa sub-cities, each with its active neighbourhoods, in English and Amharic, sorted by English name (spec G7). Saves `listingNeighbourhoodId` for **8. Listings**.

item.name: 8. Listings
item.description: The lister's listings (T2.2–T2.5) and photos (T3.2), with the app token: drafts, photos, submit, withdraw, editing in every state, reopen, close, relist. Review and browsing come later.

request.description: App token; no verification needed (L1). 201: `status: draft`, `version: 1`, every field null, `missing` lists the 15 required fields. Saves `listingId`.

Run **7. Areas** first: it saves `listingNeighbourhoodId`. `availableFrom` is set to 30 days from now by the pre-request script. 201: `missing: []`, amenities stored as `["parking", "guard"]`, the sub-city and neighbourhood named, `approxLocation` 200–400 m from `location`. Saves `listingId`. Also saves `listingPropertyId` (for photos and relisting).

body.raw:
{
  "neighbourhoodId": "{{listingNeighbourhoodId}}",
  "type": "apartment",
  "bedrooms": 2,
  "bathrooms": 1,

  "landmark": "Blue gate behind the pharmacy",
  "listerRelation": "owner",

exec: // 30 days from now (YYYY-MM-DD): available-from can't be in the past (L13).

request.description: 200: your listings in every state, newest first, with the private fields (exact point, landmark, typed neighbourhood name) that only you and staff see.

200; `version` goes up by 1. Send it again: `version` stays (nothing changed). On a live or stale listing, rent, available-from and negotiable apply at once (rent and date are recorded in the history); any other field sends it back to `pending_review`: check `status` in the answer.
`null` clears a field and `[]` clears the amenities; fields not sent are kept.
The airport. 200: a new `approxLocation` is made, 200–400 m from the new point (G2). Editing any other field keeps the old one.
Burayu, about 1.3 km outside. 400 `LOCATION_OUTSIDE_SERVICE_AREA`; the draft is unchanged. The refusal is counted in `out_of_area_demand` (rounded to ~1 km, by day, no user).
400 `BEDROOMS_ABOVE_LIMIT` with `max: 20`. Each limited field has its own code: `BATHROOMS_ABOVE_LIMIT` (20), `FLOOR_ABOVE_LIMIT` (60), `SIZE_ABOVE_LIMIT` (5000), `RENT_ABOVE_LIMIT` (2,000,000).

exec: pm.test('bedrooms over the limit', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ code: 'BEDROOMS_ABOVE_LIMIT', max: 20 }));

formdata.description: Pick a JPEG, PNG or WebP (Body tab → photo → Select files)

request.description: One photo per request, multipart field `photo`. Pick the file in the Body tab first. JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 10 MB and 50 MP; stored as a JPEG of at most 2048 px with **all metadata (GPS included) removed**. 201 with the listing; `property.photos` has signed links (15 minutes). Errors: 400 `PHOTO_REQUIRED` / `PHOTO_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED` / `PHOTO_TOO_MANY_PIXELS` / `PHOTO_UNREADABLE` / `PHOTO_UPLOAD_INVALID`, 413 `PHOTO_TOO_LARGE`, 409 `TOO_MANY_PHOTOS` (12) / `INVALID_LISTING_STATE`. Saves `photoId`. Needs `listingPropertyId`: **Create a full draft** sets it.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const photos = pm.response.json().property.photos; pm.environment.set('photoId', photos[photos.length - 1].id); }

request.description: 200 with the listing; the later photos move up. In review, live or stale with 3 photos: 409 `NOT_ENOUGH_PHOTOS`. On a live listing it goes back to review.
Every photo id of the property, each once, in the new order (the first is the cover); else 400 `PHOTO_ORDER_MISMATCH`. Applies at once, even on a live listing (no review).

Sends a draft (or a rejected listing) to staff review (L2). Checked in order: verified (403 `VERIFICATION_REQUIRED`), complete (400 `LISTING_INCOMPLETE` with `missing`), at least 3 photos (400 `NOT_ENOUGH_PHOTOS`, `min: 3`), under the cap of 10 active listings (409 `ACTIVE_LISTING_LIMIT`). Upload 3 photos first (**Upload a photo**). 200: `status: pending_review`.
Takes a listing in review back to draft. Not in review: 409 `INVALID_LISTING_STATE` (to try it before Step 3, put the listing in review with psql: see manual-testing.md).

Expired → `live` (nothing changed that needs review) or `pending_review` (`needsReview`, or never approved). Checks the same things as submit (verified, complete, 3 photos, the cap). Not expired: 409 `INVALID_LISTING_STATE`. To try it, expire the listing in psql first (manual-testing.md).

Reasons: `rented_in_app`, `rented_elsewhere` → `rented`; `no_longer_for_rent` → `removed`. `rented_in_app` only if the listing was published once (else 400 `RENTED_IN_APP_NEVER_PUBLISHED`). A draft can't be closed (delete it): 409 `INVALID_LISTING_STATE`. Saves `listingPropertyId` for **Relist**.

After the property's listings are all rented or removed: 201, a new draft with rent, advance months and negotiable copied (available-from only if it isn't past). An open or rejected listing on the property: 409 `PROPERTY_HAS_OPEN_LISTING` with its `listingId`. Saves the new `listingId`.
204: the draft, its history and (for a first draft) its property are deleted. Not a draft: 409 `INVALID_LISTING_STATE`; someone else's: 404 `LISTING_NOT_FOUND`.
No token. Live listings, newest first. Saves `browseCursor` for **Next page**.
Within 5 km (default) of the listings' **approximate** points, nearest first; `distanceMetres` rounded to 100 m. Draw each `approxLocation` as a ~500 m circle, never a pin.
Rent 10,000–40,000, at most 3 months in advance, 2+ bedrooms, cheapest first.
The page after **Browse (newest)** (same sort and filters as the request that saved the cursor; a cursor from another sort is 400 `INVALID_CURSOR`).
